title: 2nd hearing in the Ayten Korkmaz case
paragraphs: A second hearing has been held on South Daily correspondent Ayten Korkmaz on charges of spreading misleading information publicly.

According to the indictment, Ayten Korkmaz has released information that will mislead the public with the news of torpedoed appointments at the public institution published on 8 December 2025. The sentence is carried out: Turkish Penal Code 217/A (the public publicly spreading misleading information).
The trial was held in front of Mersin's 6th Criminal Court on May 8, 2026. The court adjourned the hearing until August 13, 2026.
In Ayten Korkmaz's case, Attorney Nesrin Güler said the defence witnesses were not allowed to be heard.
Ayten Korkmaz works as a reporter for Mersin at the South Newspaper, where media trade agencies have announced that they are closely monitoring the case.
The D.A.'s office will present its original debate at the next hearing, and Ayten Korkmaz is on trial without arrest.
